title: The Arch family: pacman and the AUR

sync.text: Synchronize the package database and upgrade the system with `pacman -Syu`.
sync.hint: The command changes the system and requires root: `sudo pacman -Syu`.

install.hint: `sudo pacman -S tree` and answer yes to the question.

upgrade.hint: `sudo pacman -Syu` does it all in one go.

forbered.text: Install what you need to build packages from the AUR: `git` and `base-devel`.

lagg-till.text: Download the build recipe for the AUR package `moonphase` to your home directory with `git clone`. The address is `https://aur.archlinux.org/moonphase.git`.

granska.text: Read the build recipe `PKGBUILD` before you build anything!

installera.hint: Stand in the directory `~/moonphase` and run `makepkg -si` – without sudo!

ursprung.text: List all installed packages that don't come from Arch's own repositories.

efterat.text: Bonus: install the AUR helper `yay` (the AUR package `yay-bin`) and use it to install the AUR package `snowfall`.
efterat.hint: Like before: `cd ~`, `git clone https://aur.archlinux.org/yay-bin.git`, `cd yay-bin` and `makepkg -si`. Then `yay -S snowfall` – without sudo.

vim.text: Bonus: install the Vim text editor.
vim.hint: Search with `pacman -Ss vim`. The package is called `vim`.
